objective: Without fetching model or matrix bytes, find pinned fitted-layer size/hash metadata and inspect license declaration on the fitted artifact's own README.
allowed: two bounded unauthenticated public metadata GETs
collect only source metadata hashes and declared license
blocked: download fitted tensor or main 27B model
outcome_rules: Require exact path, positive file byte size, 64-hex LFS oid to classify PUBLISHED_MATRIX_CUSTODY_METADATA_AVAILABLE.
Only actual local SHA256 of complete bytes counts as independently verified matrix; metadata hash is publisher-declared.
Use only license declared in artifact repo README frontmatter; otherwise LICENSE_UNVERIFIED.
No source-to-recipient alignment or causal concept claim regardless of metadata completeness.
If any endpoint fails or mismatches source, SOURCE_PRECHECK_BLOCKED not a scientific negative.
success_gate: Published file-size/hash/rights audit only; numerical transplantation is NOT authorized or scientifically proven.
next_admissible: If size and license allow, separately authorize/qualify bounded fitted-matrix byte hashing, then frozen source/recipient causal feature alignment with matched controls.
software_architecture: Neither native Wingless nor Yggdrasil nor TTT-Hybrid cognitive architecture may be replaced by the donor transformer.
